product_wide_rationale: Rapid-development phases change the source coordination target and delivery evidence across all Domains while preserving full main-branch verification and automated releases.
summary: Declared rapid-development phases target one expiring integration branch and record reduced local gate evidence in merge commits. Phase completion uses those merges while the installed engine stays main-based. Main consolidation uses the full merge queue, automated releases remain main-only, and law, security, data-safety, migration, and release-tooling changes keep the full standard route.
title: Rapid-development phases run the machine on a rapid branch; main and releases keep the full contract
